ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetSiteNavigation] ( @ResourceID int = 0 ) AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, NULL AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Monitor' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, NULL AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Home' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 UNION ALL
SELECT n.name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( select T.name, AUrl.[Url] as [url], 0 as feature, dbo.ArtifactNgSiteNavigation(T.ObjectID) as items from AssetType T cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'ArtifactType' WHERE not exists ( select IT.SubjectID from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on IT.Object = T.Object and IT.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 ) and v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'ArtifactType' Order By T.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Glossary' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT name, url, 0 as feature, null as items FROM ( SELECT TOP 1000 T.ObjectID, T.Name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url FROM AssetType T left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'TaxonomyType' WHERE v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'TaxonomyType' ORDER BY T.Name ) BG FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Models' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT name, url, 0 as feature, null as items FROM ( SELECT TOP 1000 T.ObjectID, T.name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url FROM AssetType T left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'PolicyType' WHERE v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'PolicyType' ORDER BY T.name ) BG FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Policy' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, null AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Reference' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 2 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT FT.name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url, 2 as feature, ( SELECT name, dbo.GenerateAssetUrl(A.ID) As url, 'F' + cast(F.ID as varchar(15)) as menuID, 2 as feature FROM Fusion F inner join Asset A on A.Object = 'Fusion' and A.ObjectID = F.ID WHERE F.FusionTypeID = FT.ID ORDER BY name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS items FROM FusionType FT inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'FusionType' and T.ObjectID = FT.ID ORDER BY name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Fusion' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 4 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT 'People' AS name, 'community/groups' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS Items FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Community' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT RT.name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url, 0 as feature, null AS items FROM RuleType RT inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'RuleType' and T.ObjectID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = RT.ID and v.Object ='RuleType' WHERE v.ObjectID IS NULL Order By RT.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Data Quality' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
/*UNION ALL SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT DISTINCT R.name, CONCAT('dashboard/', R.[ObjectType] ,'/' , R.ObjectID , '/' , R.Name) As url, 0 as feature, null AS items FROM Report R left join ReportResponsibility rs on rs.ReportID = R.ID left join ResponsibilityDetail rd on rd.ResponsibilityTypeID = rs.ResponsibilityTypeID Where @ResourceID = rd.ResourceID or rd.ResourceID is null Order By R.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Dashboards' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1*/
UNION ALL
SELECT '~' + Name AS MenuID, s.SortOrder, 0 AS Feature, s.Icon as Icon, s.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, s.Title as Title, dbo.CustomSiteNavigation(ID) AS Items from SiteNav s where ParentID IS NULL and Name not like '#%' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(s.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
order by sortorder END
changeSet.rollback:

SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 4 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT 'People' AS name, 'community/groups' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS Items FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Community' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 UNION ALL
SELECT '#Admin' as MenuID, 999 as SortOrder, 0 as Feature, 'fa-cogs' as Icon, null as ImageIconUrl, 'Administration' as Title, ( select * from ( SELECT 'Security' AS name, '#/' AS url, 0 as feature, ( select * from ( SELECT 'Groups' AS name, '#/groups/administration' AS url,
0 as feature, NULL AS items union all SELECT 'Users' AS name, '#/resources/administration' AS url,
0 as feature, NULL AS items union all SELECT 'Responsibilities' AS name, '#/governance/administration' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items ) bg FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS items
union all
SELECT 'MetaModel' AS name, '#/' AS url, 0 as feature, ( select * from ( SELECT 'Artifacts' AS name, '#/artifacts/administration' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items union all SELECT 'Attributes' AS name, '#/attributes/administration' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items union all SELECT 'Lookups' AS name, '#/lookups/administration' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items union all SELECT 'Models' AS name, '#/catalogs/administration' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items union all SELECT 'Policies' AS name, '#/policies/administration' AS url, 1 as feature, NULL AS items union all SELECT 'Relationships' AS name, '#/relations/administration' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items union all SELECT 'Rules' AS name, '#/rules/administration' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items ) bg FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS items
union all

union all
SELECT 'Reference' AS name, '#/domains/administration' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items
union all
SELECT 'Workflow' AS name, '#/workflow/administration' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items
union all
SELECT 'Templates' AS name, '#/templates/administration' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items
union all

union all
SELECT 'Settings' AS name, '#/settings' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS items ) bg for xml path('nav'), type ) as Items
where 1 = 1

changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[SiteNav] Where Name = '#Dashboards') BEGIN INSERT INTO [dbo].[SiteNav] ([ParentId],[Name],[Route],[SortOrder],[ObjectID],[Object],[Icon],[Title],[ImageIconUrl]) VALUES (null,'#Dashboards',null,(SELECT MAX([SortOrder]) FROM [dbo].[SiteNav] Where Name like '#%') , null,null,'fa-tachometer', 'Dashboards',null) END
